name: Dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
cue: Wide arc down, hug them back up
mistakes: Straightening the elbows fully, which strains the joint.
Lowering too far past shoulder level.
